summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by Wells Fargo Commercial Mortgage Securities, Inc., as depositor for a commercial mortgage-backed securities (CMBS) trust. It discloses the execution of an underwriting agreement for the sale of $475,241,000 in publicly offered certificates (Commercial Mortgage Pass-Through Certificates, Series 2026-5C10), scheduled to close on or about June 29, 2026. The filing describes the standard securitization structure, listing multiple underwriters and servicers. No special-situation event—such as a merger, acquisition, restructuring, or activist campaign—is present. This is an ordinary capital markets issuance within a pre-registered shelf program.
